n01.roman: 1997, Bengaluru. Rajesh Rao ne shuru kiya Dhruva Interactive, jise Bharat ka pehla game studio maana jaata hai.

n02.roman: Asli shuruaat 1995 mein: bank loan, papa se mile paise, ek computer aur 14.4 kbps ka modem.

n03.roman: Pehla game contract 1998 mein mila. Lekin wo game kabhi release hi nahi hua!

n04.roman: Phir Dhruva ne duniya ke bade games ke art mein haath bataya: Forza, Halo, Sea of Thieves.

n05.roman: Twist: 2019 mein GTA banane wali Rockstar Games ne Dhruva ko khareed liya, 7.9 million dollar mein!

n06.roman: Kareeb 300 log Rockstar India mein shaamil ho gaye. Ek modem se GTA wali company tak!
